name: MonarchEventPopover
title: EventPopover
wrapsNative: Content view for popover(isPresented:) with presentationCompactAdaptation(.popover), or sheet(isPresented:) with presentationDetents; Date.FormatStyle for the times; LabeledContent with .labeledContentStyle(.monarch(.inline)) for detail rows without an icon; MonarchBadge for the status; MonarchFlowLayout for the actions
summary: The content of a quick view of a calendar event: colour swatch, title, subtitle, status badge, date and time in a stated zone, labelled details, a note and actions.
whenToUse: When a tap on an event chip in a calendar, agenda or month view should show the event's essentials without leaving the screen.
whenNotToUse: For editing an event, push a form or present a sheet with the full editor. For a one-line summary inside a grid, use MonarchEventChip.
api: init(_ title: String, subtitle: String? = nil, start: Date? = nil, end: Date? = nil, isAllDay: Bool = false, color: Color? = nil, status: MonarchEventChipStatus? = nil, details: [MonarchEventPopoverDetail] = [], note: String? = nil, timeZone: TimeZone? = nil, labels: MonarchEventPopoverLabels = MonarchEventPopoverLabels(), @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

init(_ title: String, subtitle: String? = nil, start: Date? = nil, end: Date? = nil, isAllDay: Bool = false, color: Color? = nil, status: MonarchEventChipStatus? = nil, details: [MonarchEventPopoverDetail] = [], note: String? = nil, timeZone: TimeZone? = nil, labels: MonarchEventPopoverLabels = MonarchEventPopoverLabels())  // Actions == EmptyView
struct MonarchEventPopoverDetail { init(_ label: String, value: String, systemImage: String? = nil) }
struct MonarchEventPopoverLabels { var time, allDay, status: String? }

options.name: subtitle
options.description: A second line under the title, such as the calendar or the service.

options.name: start
options.description: When the event starts. Without it there is no time row.

options.name: end
options.description: When the event ends; for an all-day event its last day, inclusive. An end before the start is ignored.

options.name: isAllDay
options.description: Shows the day or day range and "All day" instead of times.

options.name: color
options.description: The event's colour for the swatch. The default is the accent role.

options.name: status
options.description: Confirmed, tentative, cancelled or declined, shown as a badge in the success, warning, neutral or danger tone.

options.name: details
options.description: Labelled rows under the time. A row with systemImage shows the icon instead of the label and still speaks the label.

options.name: note
options.description: A sentence on a subtle fill under the details, such as a cancellation reason.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: The zone the times are shown in, named after the times. The default is the environment's zone.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for Time, All day and the status name.

options.name: actions
options.description: Buttons at the bottom, laid out in a wrapping row. The app dismisses the popover from them.

states.name: spans days
states.description: The start day and time on the first line part, the end day and time and zone after it.

states.name: all day
states.description: The day or "first – last" day range, then "All day".

states.name: confirmed, tentative, cancelled, declined
states.description: A badge with the status name in its tone; cancelled and declined titles are struck through.

states.name: no time
states.description: Without start the time row is left out.

appearance: Title in the default text role, subtitle, labels, the time and the note in the muted text role, the note on the subtle background role, the swatch in the event's colour or the accent solid role, and the status badge in its tone's subtle colours. All roles keep their contrast in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web EventPopover includes its own Popover and trigger. On iOS this is the popover's content: the app presents it with .popover from the chip, which the system shows as a popover on iPad and, with .presentationCompactAdaptation(.popover), on iPhone; or as a sheet with a medium detent. The system handles dismissal and focus return. The web's hourCycle option has no counterpart: iOS follows the person's 12/24-hour setting through the locale. Product-specific statuses (the web's custom status node) are not supported; pass labels.status to rename the built-in one. Android has the same parameters.
accessibility: The title has the header trait; the swatch and the clock icon are decorative.
The status is a badge with its name in words, so it does not rely on colour; cancelled and declined titles are also struck through.
The time row is one element read as "Time" with the date and time as its value.
Each detail row is one element read as its label and value, also when it shows an icon instead of the label.
Text wraps and scales with Dynamic Type; actions wrap onto more lines when they do not fit.
edgeCases: Long titles and subtitles wrap; the status badge stays at the trailing edge.
Times are formatted in timeZone, so an event at 14:30 UTC shows as Sat 9:30 AM EST in New York and Sun 3:30 AM in Auckland.
An end earlier than the start is ignored and only the start is shown.
The popover asks for an ideal width of 320 points; on iPhone the compact popover may be narrower, and the text wraps.

examples.title: An all-day event with a note
examples.code:
MonarchEventPopover(
    "Offsite",
    start: start,
    end: start.addingTimeInterval(2 * 86_400),
    isAllDay: true,
    status: .cancelled,
    note: "Moved to next quarter."
